span.p:
PUT /config from the control plane
or the 5 s pull loop
envelope: version, sha256, signature, body

div.style: color: rgb(42, 20, 87) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1 verify
Ed25519 over version + sha256 + body

div.style: color: rgb(42, 20, 87) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 validate
JSON shape, one Host per router, unique hosts,
backends inside the sandbox CIDR or the canary,
allowed middlewares only
